# YTDL - Complete Technical Reference & Tool Manifest

YTDL (https://yt-downloader.com) is an open web utility for extracting and saving public YouTube video, audio, and thumbnail media streams without installing third-party software, browser plugins, or executable programs.

## Available Web Tools

### 1. YouTube Video Downloader
- URL: https://yt-downloader.com/
- Description: Extract video streams from public YouTube videos.
- Video Formats: MP4, WebM.
- Resolutions: 4K (2160p), 1440p (2K), 1080p Full HD, 720p HD, 480p, 360p, 240p, 144p.
- Video Codecs: H.264 (AVC1), VP9, AV1.
- Features: Real-time remuxing with audio track preservation, fast chunk streaming, progress bar indicators.

### 2. YouTube Shorts Downloader
- URL: https://yt-downloader.com/youtube-shorts-downloader
- Description: Fast downloader for vertical 9:16 aspect ratio YouTube Shorts.
- Watermark Policy: Zero watermarks, zero overlays added.
- Audio Quality: Preserves original stereo audio synchronized with the video.

### 3. YouTube to MP3 Converter
- URL: https://yt-downloader.com/youtube-to-mp3
- Description: Audio extraction tool extracting the cleanest available audio tracks from any video.
- Bitrates: 320kbps, 192kbps, 128kbps, 64kbps.
- Formats: MP3, M4A (AAC), WebM (Opus).
- Use Cases: Podcasts, background study audio, public domain music, lecture recordings.

### 4. YouTube Thumbnail Grabber
- URL: https://yt-downloader.com/youtube-thumbnail-downloader
- Description: Extracts original source cover thumbnails from any video or Short.
- Image Sizes: MaxResDefault (1920x1080), HQDefault (480x360), MQDefault (320x180), SDDefault (640x480).

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Is YTDL free?
Yes. YTDL is completely free to use with no hidden fees, subscriptions, or daily limits.

### Does YTDL store or log downloaded files?
No. YTDL streams media directly to the user's browser in real time without storing or archiving content.

### What devices are supported?
YTDL is responsive and compatible with:
- Apple iPhone and iPad (iOS / iPadOS Safari and Chrome)
- Android smartphones and tablets (Google Chrome, Samsung Internet, Firefox)
- Windows desktop & laptops (Chrome, Edge, Firefox)
- macOS (Safari, Chrome, Arc)
- Linux and Chromebooks
